    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 1
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m323_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m323_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_gold_pool value = 40 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_protected_hours_pool value = 20 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_allocated_gold value = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_allocated_hours value = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_gold_conserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_hours_conserved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_completion_performance_credit value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_certificate_only value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_manager_learning_delta value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m323_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_allocated_hours value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_certificate_only value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_manager_learning_delta value = -10 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m323_allocated_hours }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 323 learning.allocate_dual_budget"
    }
}

# 323 post-receipt business/debt deadline consumer.
zg361_cl_m323_resolve_obligation_effect = {
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m323_obligation_pending = 1 } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 323 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_object_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_object_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_object_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_object_case
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_receipt_owner
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_receipt_subject
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_receipt_cycle
                    has_variable = zg361_cl_m323_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m323_object_subject = this
                    var:zg361_cl_m323_object_owner = var:zg361_cl_m323_receipt_owner
                    var:zg361_cl_m323_object_subject = var:zg361_cl_m323_receipt_subject
                    var:zg361_cl_m323_object_cycle = var:zg361_cl_m323_receipt_cycle
                    var:zg361_cl_m323_object_case = var:zg361_cl_m323_receipt_case
                    var:zg361_cl_m323_object_revision = 1
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 323 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m323_object_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 323 }
        # A former owner cannot execute the obligation, but the orphan is
        # terminally audited so it cannot deadlock every later review cycle.
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_obligation_pending value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_obligation_orphaned value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_object_resolved value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_object_state value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_obligation_pending value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_obligation_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_object_resolved value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_object_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_learning_budget_window_closed value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m323_object_route = 3 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_debt_overdue value = 1 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_cl_m323_object_route = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_obligation_negative_outcome value = 1 }

            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m323_obligation_positive_outcome value = 1 }

            }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: resolved 323 learning_budget obligation"
    }
}

zg361_cl_m323_manager_apply_effect = {
    zg361_cl_m323_core_effect = {
        ROUTE = $ROUTE$
        TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
        TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
        TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
        TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
        TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    }
}

# 324 learning.advance_three_stages
zg361_cl_m324_core_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_cl_route value = $ROUTE$ }
    zg361_cl_clear_red_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
    EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
    EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m324_receipt_choice
} }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 3 MECHANISM = 324 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 324 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            OR = {
                liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
                AND = {
                    # AH and AI cases open in parallel.  Once #319 really
                    # moves the subject, both frozen cases may finish only
                    # under this exact settled vacancy/title postcondition.
                    var:zg361_transfer_consumer_kind = 2
                    var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 3
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 6
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_subject = this
                    liege = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
                    primary_title = var:zg361_transfer_cl_title
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_title = { holder = this }
                }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 324 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 324 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m324_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 324 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 324 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m324_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 324
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_kind_id value = 13 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_learning_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m324_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_learner value = var:zg361_cl_m324_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.824 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.824 days = 90 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_days value = 90 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.824 days = 90 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m324_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 324 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 324 } }
    }
}

# 324 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m324_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m324_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 1
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m324_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m324_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_completion_evidence value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_application_evidence value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_outcome_evidence value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_observed_delta value = 12 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_performance_credit value = 12 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_outcome_requires_application value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m324_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_application_evidence value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_outcome_evidence value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_observed_delta value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_performance_credit value = 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m324_performance_credit }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m324_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 324 learning.advance_three_stages"
    }
}

                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_case_ai_owner = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            zg361_is_reviewable_vassal_trigger = yes
            OR = {
                liege = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
                AND = {
                    # AH and AI cases open in parallel.  Once #319 really
                    # moves the subject, both frozen cases may finish only
                    # under this exact settled vacancy/title postcondition.
                    var:zg361_transfer_consumer_kind = 2
                    var:zg361_transfer_vacancy_status = 3
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_phase = 6
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_owner = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_subject = this
                    liege = var:zg361_transfer_cl_receiver
                    primary_title = var:zg361_transfer_cl_title
                    var:zg361_transfer_cl_title = { holder = this }
                }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 1 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                OR = {
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 1
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 2
                    scope:zg361_cl_route = 3
                }
            }
        }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                trigger_if = {
                                    limit = { has_variable = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending }
                                    var:zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending = 0
                                }
                                trigger_else = { always = yes }
            } } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 4 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { always = yes } }
        zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 325 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_dual_payment_ready value = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { var:zg361_cl_m325_dual_payment_ready = 1 }
            zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ai_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ai_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_state
                REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_revision
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_active
                TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_timeline_serial
                FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ai_feedback_revision
                LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_operation
                LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ai_last_choice
                RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_owner
                RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_subject
                RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_cycle
                RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_case
                RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_state
                RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
                TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
                CHOICE = scope:zg361_cl_route
                OPERATION_ID = 325
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumed value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_deferred value = 0 }

                # A receipt now owns one typed object identity.  A/B activate
                # the business object; C activates only a due governance debt.
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_kind_id value = 14 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_serial value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_revision value = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_consumer_revision value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_resolved value = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_relation_manager value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_relation_official value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_training_owner value = var:zg361_cl_m325_object_owner }
                set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_assessed_official value = var:zg361_cl_m325_object_subject }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_active value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_debt_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_acl_class value = 0 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_active value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_debt_active value = 0 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_acl_class value = 1 }
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_acl_class value = 2 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.825 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 2 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.825 days = 30 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 30 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_route value = scope:zg361_cl_route }
                    trigger_event = { id = zg361cl.825 days = 30 }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_pending value = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_obligation_days value = 0 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:zg361_cl_route = 3 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_deferred value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_debt_due_cycle value = { value = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumer_value value = 0 }
                }
                else = { zg361_cl_m325_consume_effect = yes }
            }
            else = {

                zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 2 MECHANISM = 325 }
            }
        }
        else = { zg361_cl_set_red_effect = { CODE = 5 MECHANISM = 325 } }
    }
}

# 325 consumer: frozen receipt -> domain projection.
zg361_cl_m325_consume_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
    RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_owner
    RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_subject
    RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_cycle
    RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_case
    RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_state
    RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
    EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_ai_owner
    EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
    EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_ai_cycle_serial
    EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_ai_case_serial
    EXPECTED_STATE = 1
    EXPECTED_CHOICE = var:zg361_cl_m325_receipt_choice
}
            NOT = { var:zg361_cl_m325_route = 3 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_certificate_passed value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_practical_score value = 30 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_practical_threshold value = 60 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_test_valid value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_competent value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_training_owner_audit value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_automatic_low_grade value = 0 }
            if = { limit = { var:zg361_cl_m325_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_test_valid value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_training_owner_audit value = 1 } }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumer_value value = var:zg361_cl_m325_competent }

        change_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_consumer_revision add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_object_state value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_cl_m325_consumed value = 1 }
        debug_log = "ZG361CL: consumed 325 learning.assess_practical_competence"
    }
}
